fields.name: ECVTMaxCoreID
fields.description: When CvtProcAsCore is on, the maximum CPU Core Id allowed in the system for this IPL. When CvtProcAsCore is off, this will be set to CVTMAXMP.

fields.name: ECVTNumCPUIDsInCore
fields.description: The maximum number of CPUs that can "fit" on a CPU Core. This doesn't mean all of them can be active. This can be looked at as how many IDs exist between thread 0 of two contiguous cores. When CvtProcAsCore is off, this will be set to 1.

fields.name: ECVT_OSProtect_WhenSystem

Current possible values are: X'01' indicating OSPROTECT=1 (not on zPDT), X'FF' indicating OSPROTECT=MIN (on zPDT) A value in the range x'01'-x'FE' indicates "more than minimum"

fields.name: Ecvt_BoostInfo
fields.description: Valid only when CVTBoost is on

Ecvt_IplBoosts_Activated.description: All IPL boosts to be activated have been activated.

Ecvt_SDBoosts_Activated.description: All Shutdown boosts to be activated have been activated.

Ecvt_RPBoosts_Activated.description: All RP boosts to be activated have been activated. This bit will be turned off once the boost ends.

Ecvt_BoostClass.description: See Ecvt_BoostClass_xxx equates. Valid only when one of the boosts is active

Ecvt_Sysparm_zIIPBoost.description: According to the availability and the BOOST system parameter, we want to do zIIP boost. This gets turned off if it could never be right to activate, such as for the case of a non-dedicated partition

Ecvt_Sysparm_SpeedBoost.description: According to the availability and the BOOST system parameter, we want to do speed boost.

fields.name: Ecvt_BoostInfo_TransientZiipCores
fields.description: Number of zIIP cores configured online for the zIIP boost. Those cores will be configured offline at the end of the zIIP boost. Valid only when the zIIP boost active bit is on.

Ecvt_RPB_Disabled.description: When on, RP boosts are disabled When off, RP boosts are enabled

fields.name: Ecvt_BoostLevel
fields.description: 0: initial deliverable >0: In addition to initial deliverable data,

equates.name: Ecvt_BoostLevel_V0
equates.description: Initial deliverable

equates.name: Ecvt_BoostLevel_V1
equates.description: Ecvt_BoostInfo_V1 may also be examined

equates.name: Ecvt_BoostLevel_V2
equates.description: Ecvt_BoostInfo_V2 may also be examined

equates.name: Ecvt_BoostLevel_V3
equates.description: Also, additional SMF record fields

equates.name: Ecvt_BoostLevel_Max
equates.description: Maximum level of support. This may change in the future.

fields.name: Ecvt_BoostInfo_Expected_EndETOD
fields.description: Time (STCKE format) when boost(s) will end. It is valid when the following is true: -- one of the "Boost Active" bits is on, and -- if the boost class is IPL, bit Ecvt_IplBoosts_Activated is on, and -- if the boost class is shutdown, bit Ecvt_SDBoosts_Activated is on, and -- if the boost class is RP, bit Ecvt_RPBoosts_Activated is on. End time can be extended if there are

fields.name: Ecvt_BoostInfo_V1
fields.description: Recovery process boost support. Valid when Ecvt_BoostLevel is at least Ecvt_BoostLevel_V1

fields.name: Ecvt_RPBoosts_Num
fields.description: Number of recovery-process boost start requests received across the life of the IPL that were not during IPL boost or shutdown boost

fields.name: Ecvt_RPBoosts_Num_Ignored
fields.description: Number of recovery-process boost start requests received across the life of the IPL that were ignored because the duration limit had been exceeded

fields.name: Ecvt_RPB_Duration
fields.description: Total duration for the life of the IPL of recovery process boosts. Updated when RP boost is extended or ends. In STCK format.

fields.name: Ecvt_RP_Duration
fields.description: Same as Ecvt_RPB_Duration

fields.name: Ecvt_RP_BoostInfo_Flags1
fields.description: Same as Ecvt_RPB_BoostInfo_Flags1

Ecvt_RPBoosts_Last_EndedByTimer.description: The last RPBoost(s) ended by timer. Valid only when RPBoost inactive.

Ecvt_RPBoosts_Last_EndedByShutdown.description: The last RPBoost(s) ended due to shutdown. Valid only when RPBoost inactive.

Ecvt_RPBoosts_Last_EndedByError.description: The last RPBoost(s) ended due to error. Valid only when RPBoost inactive.

fields.name: Ecvt_RPBoosts_Requestor_ID
fields.description: The requestor ID associated with the start or extend. Updated when the boost is extended. Valid only when RP boost(s) are active. See equates ECVT_RPBReq_xxx

fields.name: Ecvt_RPBoosts_NumByRequestor_Addr
fields.description: Address of an area that has the number of RP boost requests by each requestor. The format of the area is: 1st word - number of entries. 2nd word - number of requests by unidentified requestors. Nth word when N > 2 - number of requests by requestor N-2. The requestors are described by ID (the "N-2" value).

fields.name: Ecvt_RPBoosts_Num_WhileDis
fields.description: Number of recovery-process boost start requests received across the life of the IPL while RP boosts were disabled

fields.name: Ecvt_RPB_Duration_Potential
fields.description: Total duration for the life of the IPL of recovery process boosts. Includes time that would have been boosted except for having reached the duration limit. Includes time regardless of whether or not RP boosts were enabled. Updated when RP boost would be extended or end. In STCK format.

fields.name: Ecvt_RPB_Duration_Potential_E
fields.description: Same as preceding field, but only while RP Boosts are enabled

fields.name: Ecvt_RPB_En_Dis_Local_Timestamp
fields.description: Local time when RP boosts were last enabled or disabled. In STCK format.

fields.name: EcvtR430
fields.description: Reserved

fields.name: Ecvt_zIIPBoostCoresAddr
fields.description: When not 0, the address of an area that is a bit string of which cores were config'd online for a boost. Each bit corresponds to a core (bit 0 is core 0, bit 1 is core 1, etc). When bit n is on, core n is considered a zIIP boost core

fields.name: Ecvt_IFunc_Addr
fields.description: Address of area mapped by IHAIFUNC indicating which function codes of such instructions as PRNO, KIMD, KLMD are available.

fields.name: ECVTR43C
fields.description: Reserved

fields.name: ECVT_MaxTOD
fields.description: A value that will not be reached by the clock comparator for this IPL. That is x'FFFFFFFF_FFFFFFFF' when a signed CC is not used, x'7FFFFFFF_FFFFFFFF' when a signed CC is used

equates.name: ECVT_max_highestCPUID
equates.description: The highest physical CPU ID allowed in a z/OS system.  If you use this equate, you must be prepared to reassemble if this value changes in a new release.  IBM recommends using CVTMAXMP at runtime.

equates.name: ECVT_max_CPUMaskSizeInBits
equates.description: The maximum number of bits needed to allocate storage at assemble time to guarantee enough storage to hold a full CPU mask of any current or prior release. If you use this equate, you must be prepared to reassemble if this value changes in a new release. IBM recommends using CVTMAXMP at runtime.

equates.name: ECVT_max_CPUMaskSizeInBytes
equates.description: /8 The maximum number of bytes needed to allocate storage at assemble time to guarantee enough storage to hold a full CPU mask of of any current or prior release. If you use this equate, you must be prepared to reassemble if this value changes in a new release. IBM recommends using ECVTMaxMPNumBytesInMask at runtime.

equates.name: ECVT_zOSV2R1_highestCPUID
equates.description: The highest physical CPU ID allowed in a z/OS system up to and including z/OS V2R1.  This constant will never change.  IBM recommends using CVTMAXMP at runtime.

equates.name: ECVT_zOSV2R1_CPUMaskSizeInBits
equates.description: The number of bits needed to allocate storage at assemble time to guarantee enough storage to hold a full CPU mask up to and including release z/OS V2R1. This constant will never change. IBM recommends using CVTMAXMP at runtime.

equates.name: ECVT_zOSV2R1_CPUMaskSizeInBytes
equates.description: /8 Number of bytes needed to allocate storage at assemble time to guarantee enough storage to hold a full CPU mask up to and including release z/OS V2R1.  This constant will never change.  IBM recommends using ECVTMaxMPNumBytesInMask at runtime.

equates.name: ECVT_zOSR11_highestCPUID
equates.description: The highest physical CPU ID allowed in a z/OS system up to and including z/OS V1R11.  This constant will never change.  IBM recommends using CVTMAXMP at runtime.

equates.name: ECVT_zOSR11_CPUMaskSizeInBits
equates.description: The number of bits needed to allocate storage at assemble time to guarantee enough storage to hold a full CPU mask up to and including release z/OS V1R11. This constant will never change. IBM recommends using CVTMAXMP at runtime.
